card.text: Explore 2P/Encke through a shape approximation constrained by radar observations.

introduction.text: Encke returns to the Sun roughly every 3.3 years. Radar echoes and infrared measurements suggest a long, narrow nucleus, though its tumbling motion makes the exact shape uncertain.

model.title: Radar and infrared model
model.summary: This smooth model follows one published radar and infrared solution for Encke. Its shape depends on the assumed tumbling motion. The grid marks absent surface photographs; the orientation is illustrative.
